positioning_statement: Braind AI is the AI implementation partner for growth-stage companies who are tired of AI hype and want practical systems that actually work. Unlike generic AI consultants who deliver strategy decks, or tool vendors who sell point solutions, we architect complete AI operating systems that transform how your business thinks, decides, and executes - delivering measurable ROI within 90 days.

core_offers.name: AI Operating System Build
core_offers.description: Complete AI infrastructure implementation over 8-12 weeks including custom agents, integrations, and team training
core_offers.ideal_for: Companies ready to make a significant AI investment and want comprehensive transformation
core_offers.key_deliverables: Custom AI agents, workflow automation, integrations with existing stack, team training, documentation, 90-day optimization support

core_offers.name: Fractional AI Officer
core_offers.description: Ongoing strategic partnership with weekly calls, unlimited async support, and quarterly roadmap planning
core_offers.ideal_for: Companies who want continuous AI leadership without the cost of a full-time executive hire
core_offers.key_deliverables: Weekly strategy sessions, priority implementation support, AI roadmap development, vendor evaluation, team coaching

core_offers.name: AI Pilot Program
core_offers.description: 30-day proof-of-concept implementation of one AI system with full documentation and training
core_offers.ideal_for: Companies who want to test the waters with a lower-risk initial engagement
core_offers.key_deliverables: One fully implemented AI system, ROI documentation, team training, implementation playbook

core_offers.name: Braind Platform Pro
core_offers.description: Full access to AI tool suite plus monthly strategy calls and priority support
core_offers.ideal_for: Companies who want ongoing access to AI tools and guidance at a predictable monthly cost
core_offers.key_deliverables: Platform access, monthly strategy call, priority support queue, community access

welcome: Email 1 (Day 0): Deliver lead magnet, set expectations for what is coming, quick intro to Govind and Braind AI philosophy
Email 2 (Day 2): The biggest mistake companies make with AI (and how to avoid it) - pure value, no pitch
Email 3 (Day 4): Framework for evaluating AI opportunities in your business - actionable and insightful
nurture: Email 4 (Day 7): Case study deep-dive - specific results for a company like theirs
Email 5 (Day 10): Common objections addressed honestly - what AI can and cannot do
Email 6 (Day 14): The AI Operating System concept explained - how everything connects
Email 7 (Day 21): Soft CTA - invitation to book discovery call if timing is right
Weekly newsletter: Ongoing value with curated insights, Govind's latest thinking, relevant tools and resources
sales: Post-discovery call (Day 1): Recap conversation, confirm next steps, attach any promised resources
Proposal sent (Day 2): Proposal delivery with context and invitation to discuss
Proposal follow-up (Day 5): Check in, answer questions, address concerns
Decision support (Day 7): Final case study or testimonial relevant to their situation
Close or pause (Day 10): Respectful close attempt or mutual agreement to revisit when timing is better
retargeting: Re-engagement (90 days inactive): Share new case study or insight with soft check-in
Seasonal touchpoint (quarterly): Relevant update tied to business planning cycles (Q1 planning, mid-year review)
Trigger-based: Automated send when prospect company announces funding, leadership change, or other relevant news
newsletter: Weekly format: One main insight or framework, curated links to relevant AI developments, occasional behind-the-scenes peek
Monthly deep-dive: Longer analysis of a trending topic or detailed case study
Quarterly: State of AI for business leaders - summary of what matters and what is hype

organic: LinkedIn (Govind's personal profile) - Primary channel, 3-5 posts per week, active engagement in comments
SEO blog content - Long-form articles targeting high-intent keywords around AI implementation
Podcast guesting - Monthly appearances on business and technology podcasts
YouTube - Repurposed content and occasional tutorials (secondary priority)
paid: LinkedIn Ads - Retargeting website visitors and engagement audiences, lead magnet promotion
Google Ads - Limited testing on high-intent search terms (AI consultant, AI implementation help)
Sponsorships - Newsletter sponsorships in relevant business publications (The Hustle, Morning Brew tech segment)
referral: Client referral program - Informal but cultivated, thank-you gifts for referrals, case study participation
Partner referrals - Reciprocal relationships with complementary service providers (dev agencies, marketing consultants)
Network referrals - Active cultivation of VC, PE, and founder network for warm introductions
social: Twitter/X - Repurposed LinkedIn content, engagement with AI and business communities (secondary)
LinkedIn Company Page - Company updates and job postings (minimal investment vs personal brand)
search: SEO strategy focused on long-tail, high-intent keywords: 'AI implementation for SaaS companies', 'AI consultant for growing business', 'how to implement AI in operations'
Case study pages optimized for industry-specific searches
Pillar content strategy with topic clusters around core themes
